# What should you charge this bookkeeping client each month, and which current clients are underpaying you?

> Price a monthly bookkeeping retainer from transactions, accounts, payroll, AR/AP and sales-tax filings: the minimum fee for your target hourly, a recommended fee, a one-time cleanup quote, a walk-away price, and a roster that ranks existing clients by effective hourly. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
